review.assumptionsToDischarge: For an actual holomorphic fraction F*b=a with a,b in the original cyclotomic j/Fricke algebra and b nonzero, a supplied actual complex monic j-relation descends to an actual monic relation with coefficients in the cyclotomic field. The cyclotomic Laurent representation and periodicity are derived, not assumed. The literal substituted j-series is identified with the original analytic j at width N. Actual periodic holomorphic functions with finite cusp poles have Laurent representations.
review.remaining: The input complex monic relation is explicit; the prior modular-orbit theorem supplies it under actual principal-level invariance and finite cusp-pole hypotheses. Integral base-change spanning, rational Fourier spanning, arbitrary Gamma1 cusp differential realization and the converse remain. Picard/H1, full/parabolic/transpose/diamond, Frobenius/inertia and original all-weight arithmetic association, automorphy and literal higher continuation remain. 16/20; DUB-17--20 OPEN.
review.route: Reuse the existing meromorphic cusp-germ field operations and uniqueness, native analytic identity/domain theorems, integral discriminant coefficients, the existing width formula and Laurent reindexing, and the already proved coefficient-linear-retraction descent. A duplicate reindex proof was removed before audit in favor of SourceIntegralPowerSeriesFrobenius. This replaces the selected external monic-coefficient proof route without importing its large linear-system and Fourier flatness machinery or increasing limits. Integral constant-extension spanning is a separate unresolved step; no characteristic-zero Hecke lift is inferred. All final sources receive a fresh sequential rebuild before auditing.
